MPL_16+47+54+44_notes.md.heading: F15 — Cote 47, scan 9, question about torsion
MPL_16+47+54+44_notes.md.excerpt: A useful later comparison distinguishes a particular bundle’s integral Chern classes from an integral Fourier transform on the entire Chow group. Beckmann and de Gaay Fortman (2023, Theorem 3.8) characterize integral lifts of the Poincaré character using a specific one-cycle; under a symmetric ample principal polarization, they also relate this to preservation of Chow groups modulo torsion and to weak integral Fourier transforms. These additional hypotheses and the distinction between rational identities and integral lifts prevent the manuscript’s local heuristic from being treated as a general integral-transform theorem.
